sources.title: Deep Research preview: exact agent specifications
sources.evidence: Labels the exact identifier an Interactions API agent code; specifies 1,048,576 input tokens, text/image/PDF/audio/video inputs, and cited text/image outputs. Freshly reopened on October 27: the exact agent specification does not publish total or active learned-parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: April 21, 2026 explicitly releases deep-research-preview-04-2026 and the separate Max version. October 8 migration guidance still names both April agents as successors to the December agent.

sources.title: Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents
sources.evidence: Dated April 21 launch distinguishes the speed-oriented Deep Research agent from Max. Names Gemini 3.1 Pro as the research model and HTML or Nano Banana for visualizations; describes research, citations and MCP tools. Freshly reopened on October 27: this explicit named-backbone relationship is a valid lineage lead, but the launch supplies no nominal parameter size to inherit.

sources.title: Gemini Deep Research agent guide
sources.evidence: Exact-ID examples document collaborative planning, intermediate reasoning summaries, generated images, search, URL Context, code execution, File Search and remote MCP. The limitations section excludes custom function-calling tools. This is a managed workflow using underlying Gemini models. Freshly reopened on October 27: request parameters are API settings, not learned weights. The guide contains no total/active weight counts; its separate Gemini 4 Argon follow-up example does not change the named April backbone.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is governed by proprietary service terms; extraction or replication of underlying models and parameter weights is prohibited. The documentation page copyright licenses are not weight licenses.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro model card
sources.evidence: The announced research backbone is based on Gemini 3 Pro and explicitly delegates architecture details to that model card. Lists API/product distribution and performance comparisons, but no total or active parameter count. The complete current card was independently inspected again on October 27; neither a nominal total nor an activated-parameter comparison is present.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: The later card explicitly describes sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture and identifies Gemini 3.1 Pro among its derivatives. It does not provide production parameter counts or define an architecture for the complete Deep Research agent. The complete redirected model-card PDF was independently inspected again on October 27, including the derivative-model descriptions and tables; parameter mentions describe sparse routing without numerical counts.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card, October 2026
sources.evidence: Later first-party card compares safety results with Gemini 3.1 Pro but supplies no total/active parameter counts for that model or this Deep Research agent. Its own architecture is not attributed to the April agent. The complete current card was independently inspected again on October 27. Its evaluation tables do not supply a parameter-count column for Gemini 3.1 Pro.

sources.title: Models.dev exact agent record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead provides the display name and gemini-pro grouping and links to the primary agent specification, guide and launch announcement. Technical claims were checked against those primary sources.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The complete later first-party card was independently inspected on October 27. It compares Gemini 3.1 Pro safety results but provides no total or active parameter count for that backbone.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Safety Report
sources.evidence: The complete later first-party report was independently inspected on October 27, including Gemini 3.1 Pro comparisons and the report tables. Its parameter mentions concern task difficulty, weight security and encoded knowledge; no total/activated-parameter table discloses the April agent backbone size.

sources.title: Google (Gemini) — GPT-5.6 Pro deep dive
sources.publisher: Frontier Inference Margins, independent research artifact
sources.evidence: Fresh named-backbone parameter search lead opened on October 27. This LLM-generated research artifact explicitly labels 3T total and 120B active as speculative scenario midpoints, with judgmental ranges, not measured estimates or Google specifications. It supplies no count that can be verified for Gemini 3.1 Pro.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Technical Deep Dive
sources.evidence: Fresh named-backbone parameter search lead opened on October 27. Its architecture section says Google has not disclosed parameter counts, then attributes greater-than-1T total and 50–80B activated to industry estimates based on latency/throughput. It identifies no primary count source or defensible derivation, so these are not verified nominal counts or bounds.

name.note: Retains the catalog display name for the Gemini Deep Research agent preview; exact April identifier is verified.

developer.note: Official Google API documentation and Google DeepMind launch announcement.

family.note: Retains the catalog grouping because the launch explicitly names Gemini 3.1 Pro as its research backbone; this is not a standalone Pro checkpoint.

release_date.note: Exact April agent release is dated explicitly; the earlier December Deep Research release is a different identifier.

open_weights.note: Distributed as a managed Interactions API agent under service terms, without downloadable agent weights.

license.note: Proprietary hosted-service classification; not an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 searches for the exact April identifier and its explicitly named Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone found no developer-published nominal total. The complete Gemini 3.1 Pro card delegates architecture to Gemini 3 Pro, but that named base also has no disclosed count to inherit. Later Gemini 3.8 Flash/4 Argon cards and the full Gemini 4 safety report do not disclose it. The secondary 3T scenario is expressly speculative and the greater-than-1T estimate is unattributed. Both remain unusable as specifications. The null reflects missing backbone evidence, not the presence of search tools or a missing tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-model and named-backbone searches and later first-party comparison tables found no published activated-parameter count for Gemini 3.1 Pro or the April agent. Sparse MoE architecture alone supplies no number. The secondary 120B figure is an explicitly speculative scenario midpoint; the 50–80B claim is an unattributed latency/throughput estimate. Neither establishes a nominal active count, and no total-to-active equality is inferred.

architecture.note: This identifier is an orchestrated agent, not one neural checkpoint. Its announced Gemini 3.1 Pro research backbone is documented as a sparse MoE Transformer through its referenced card; optional Nano Banana visualization makes that an incomplete agent-wide classification.

context_window.note: Exact agent specification lists 1,048,576 input-context tokens; this is separate from aggregate tokens consumed over a research workflow.

modalities.note: Exact agent specification supports all listed input types and cited-text/image output. Image output is an agent visualization capability.

reasoning.note: Agent plans and reasons through research, with optional intermediate reasoning summaries.

tool_call.note: Supports built-in tools and remote MCP servers. Custom function-calling tools are explicitly unsupported; the true flag describes agent tool use.

description.value: Managed research agent for autonomous multi-step investigations, synthesis, and cited reports.
description.note: Replaces the ambiguous agentic-model wording with the documented managed-agent identity.

patch.description: Managed research agent for autonomous multi-step investigations, synthesis, and cited reports.
patch.notes: Built with Gemini 3.1 Pro, whose model card describes a sparse MoE Transformer. Google does not disclose total or active parameters for that backbone. The managed agent supports built-in tools and remote MCP servers, but excludes custom function-calling tools.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit reopened the exact April agent documentation and launch, independently inspected the complete Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3 Pro cards, and checked later Gemini 3.8 Flash/4 Argon cards and the full Gemini 4 safety report. The explicit Gemini 3.1 Pro backbone relationship is established, but neither it nor its named base has a published total or active size to inherit. Fresh searches found only explicitly speculative or unattributed numerical estimates. Both parameter patch values remain explicitly null/undisclosed. Other audited fields are unchanged.
